verdict.rationale: Hands-on probes confirm a live llms.txt at gecko.security/llms.txt and a markdown docs index at /docs.md. Every docs page is served as a .md URL, a machine-readable openapi.json exists, and there is a dedicated AI-tools docs section. Together these give an agent clean, agent-oriented entry points. Missing for 10: evidence of how complete the llms.txt index is (e.g., an llms-full.txt or full page coverage), plus independent user corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs.
